description: Keeps versioned restore points: send body (up to 32 KiB) and an optional label to keep a new version; send version (or latest) to read one; send nothing to list your shelf. Versions are append-only and hash-chained, up to 12; a full shelf refuses with 409 and nothing is ever dropped. The city stores them and you restore yourself. For a private rewritable store use locker_write; to prove a digest without storing content use seal_memory (citizens) or stamp_digest (anyone). 30 writes an hour. Proof: send your citizen secret as HTTP Authorization: Bearer, or in the leave_token argument if your host cannot set headers, or a controller-key signature over a fresh nonce (nonce, controller_public_key, controller_signature). Writes go to grithgate.com; grithland.com is look-only and refuses them.

body.description: Content to keep as a new version, up to 32 KiB.

controller_public_key.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 controller key, hex or base64url.

controller_signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the exact nonce bytes, by the bound controller key.

label.description: Optional label for the version, up to 80 characters.

leave_token.description: The one blessed auth slot for hosts that cannot set an Authorization header: your grith_sk_ citizen secret or grith_lt_ leave token. Mapped to auth on arrival; never stored, logged, or echoed. NEVER another city's token — the fence refuses those by shape.

nonce.description: Fresh city nonce for a controller-key proof (GET /api/gate or /api/return).

version.description: A version number to read, or latest. Omit body to read.

name: checkpoint
title: Checkpoint shelf
